name: Billbug: Intrusion Campaign Against Southeast Asia Continues | Symantec Enterprise Blogs
IOC&TTP - Lotus Blossom espionage group targets multiple industries with different versions of Sagerunex and hacking tools
description:
Cisco Talos 发现多个网络间谍活动，目标涵盖政府、制造业、电信和媒体行业。这些攻击活动通过 Sagerunex 后门及其他黑客工具进行渗透，实施长期的网络攻击。Talos 高度确信这些行动由**Lotus Blossom（又称 Spring Dragon、Billbug、Thrip）**组织主导，该组织自 2012 年以来一直活跃。

调查发现，Lotus Blossom 通过系统注册表植入 Sagerunex 并配置其作为服务运行，实现长期驻留。此外，该组织开发了多种 Sagerunex 变种，其中一些变种使用Dropbox、Twitter 和 Zimbra 开源邮件系统作为命令与控制（C2）通道，以规避检测。

在分析攻击手法时，Talos 发现该组织不仅调整了后门工具的持久性策略，还采用了一系列黑客工具，包括：

浏览器 Cookie 窃取工具（窃取 Chrome 及 Firefox 浏览器凭据）；
Venom 代理工具（用于连接受害者设备与互联网）；
权限提升工具（绕过访问控制）；
归档工具（压缩并加密敏感数据以便窃取）；
端口转发工具 mtrain V1.01（用于网络中继连接）。
研究显示，Lotus Blossom 组织的攻击链通常包括多个阶段，利用 Impacket 工具远程执行命令，并通过公用文件夹隐藏恶意代码。此外，Sagerunex 变种在执行前会进行系统时间检查、代理配置适配及反调试检测，以确保隐蔽性。某些变种更进一步，使用 Zimbra API 作为 C2 机制，并通过邮件草稿文件窃取受害者信息。

Talos 确认该组织的 Sagerunex 变种自 2016 年以来一直活跃，并通过持续优化技术手段提升隐蔽性和适应性。此次分析的发现强调了 Lotus Blossom 组织对网络攻击手法的不断升级，并表明该组织依然在多个国家及行业中开展大规模间谍活动。

name: Billbug: State-sponsored Actor Targets Cert Authority, Government Agencies in Multiple Asian Countries | Symantec Enterprise Blogs
description: A state-sponsored actor has compromised a digital certificate authority in an Asian country, according to security firm Symantec. and it has been linked to a group that has previously been identified as Billbug.

name: Conference Invite used as a Lure by Operation Lotus Blossom Actors
description: Actors related to the Operation Lotus Blossom campaign continue their attack campaigns in the Asia Pacific region. It appears that these threat actors have begun using Palo Alto Networks upcoming Cyber Security Summit hosted on November 3, 2016 in Jakarta, Indonesia as a lure to compromise targeted individuals. The payload installed in attacks using this lure is a variant of the Emissary Trojan that we have analyzed in the past, which has direct links to threat actors associated with Operation Lotus Blossom.

name: Emissary Trojan/ Operation Lotus Blossom Update
description:
In December 2015, Unit 42 published a blog about a cyber espionage attack using the Emissary Trojan as a payload. Emissary is related to the Elise Trojan and the Operation Lotus Blossom attack campaign, which prompted us to start collecting additional samples of Emissary.
The oldest sample we found was created in 2009, indicating this tool has been in use for almost seven years. Of note, this is three years earlier than the oldest Elise sample we have found, suggesting this group has been active longer than previously documented. In addition, Emissary appears to only be used against Taiwanese or Hong Kong based targets, all of the decoys are written in Traditional Chinese, and they use themes related to the government or military.

name: Attack on French Diplomat Linked to Operation Lotus Blossom
description:
PaloAlto observed a targeted attack in November directed at an individual working for the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The attack involved a spear-phishing email sent to a single French diplomat based in Taipei, Taiwan and contained an invitation to a Science and Technology support group event.
The actors attempted to exploit CVE-2014-6332 using a slightly modified version of the proof-of-concept (POC) code to install a Trojan called Emissary, which is related to the Operation Lotus Blossom campaign. The TTPs used in this attack also match those detailed in the paper. The targeting of this individual suggests the actors are interested in breaching the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs itself or gaining insights into relations between France and Taiwan.

name: The Spring Dragon APT
description: Let’s examine a couple of interesting delivery techniques from an APT active for the past several years, the Spring Dragon APT. A paper released today by our colleagues at Palo Alto Networks presented a portion of data on this crew under the label “the Lotus Blossom Operation“, likely named for the debug string present in much of the "Elise" codebase since at least 2012: “d:\lstudio\projects\lotus\…”.

name: OPERATION LOTUS BLOSSOM
description: Operation Lotus Blossom describes a persistent cyber espionage campaign against government and military organizations in Southeast Asia. The report exposes the targets, tools, and attack techniques, and provides full details on the Lotus Blossom campaign, including all indicators of compromise.
